messages:
elaine.support: Heads-up: Acme Inc opened a critical SSO ticket. After an IdP signing cert rotation + CDN change, a subset of users see 403s at our ACS with 'AssertionRecipientMismatch' and 'Signature verification error'. They attached the SAML response and our gateway logs.

maria.cs: Which environment and exact log lines? paste the gateway excerpt and the <SubjectConfirmation Recipient='...'> value.

elaine.support: Prod. Gateway snippet they sent: 
```
2026-07-21T12:04:08Z ERROR  sso.gateway Req=Zx12 reject AssertionRecipientMismatch recipient=https://origin-edge.acmecdn.net/acs expected=https://acme.redwood-inference.example/acs
2026-07-21T12:04:08Z WARN   sso.gateway Signature verification failed: fingerprint=9F:1A:3D:... (unknown)
```

acme.admin: Confirmed we rolled signing cert at 03:00 UTC and enabled origin-host-rewrite on the CDN. Some auths work, others fail depending on path to edge.

vikram.eng: Two likely simultaneous causes: (1) CDN rewrites Host/origin so SubjectConfirmation Recipient != registered ACS; (2) the new signing cert isn't in our keystore so signature verification fails. The SAML they attached shows Recipient set to https://origin-edge.acmecdn.net/acs and KeyInfo includes two certificates; signature uses the second (new) cert.

jorge.sre: Actionable repro/triage steps for customer (short):
1) Confirm the exact Recipient value in their failing SAML (`xmllint --xpath "string(//SubjectConfirmation/@Recipient)" resp.xml`).
2) Share IdP metadata URL and confirm it contains the new X509Certificate entry and last-modified/ETag.
3) Provide sha256 fingerprint of the new cert (`openssl x509 -in idp.crt -noout -fingerprint -sha256`).
4) If CDN is rewriting Host, ask them to preserve Host header to origin or set origin_host_header to the canonical ACS host.

elaine.support: Suggested mitigations we can offer now: (A) short-lived keystore add on our side if they provide cert fingerprint/metadata (we'll open CKU ticket), (B) configure an ACS alias for this tenant to accept origin-edge.acmecdn.net temporarily, (C) ask IdP to fallback to old key (they said rotation policy prevents rollback).

acme.admin: We can't rollback (HSM + rotation policy). We'll try host-preserve and also give you metadata URL + cert fingerprint.

vikram.eng: Engineering notes:
- Our gateway enforces strict recipient equality to the registered ACS. We can add per-tenant `acs_aliases` to accept alternate recipients; small config change to edge config (fast but needs canary).
- Metadata poller respects caching headers (ETag/Cache-Control). If IdP metadata updated but served with strong caching, our poller may not pick it up. We should force-refresh for this tenant when they provide metadata URL.
- Keystore: manual addition needs security owner approval. CKU flow created automatically if support requests it.

jorge.sre: Commands to verify from customer's side (send to them):
- curl metadata and show headers: `curl -I https://idp.acme.example/metadata.xml`
- fetch and format: `curl -sS https://idp.acme.example/metadata.xml | xmllint --format -`
- extract cert and fingerprint: `xmllint --xpath "string(//KeyDescriptor//X509Certificate)" metadata.xml | base64 -d > idp.crt && openssl x509 -noout -fingerprint -sha256 -in idp.crt`

elaine.support: I'll send those exact commands and ask for metadata URL + fingerprint. Offering ACS alias and temporary keystore add as options. cc @vikram.eng @jorge.sre

deploy.bot: Created CKU-900 for manual keystore addition (pending owner approval).

acme.admin: Metadata URL: https://idp.acme.example/metadata.xml. Fingerprint (sha256)=9F:1A:3D:... . We've toggled host-preserve on origin and will report in 15m.

maria.cs: Thanks. Support next steps: (1) verify metadata endpoint reachability from our poller and paste fetch timestamps/headers, (2) if host-preserve fixes recipient mismatches we'll still need to add the cert or force-refetch metadata to resolve signature errors, (3) offer ACS alias window (48h) if CDN changes take longer.

vikram.eng: Platform action items:
- SRE: temporarily accept `origin-edge.acmecdn.net` as acs_alias for tenant acme (short-lived flag).
- Infra: check metadata poller logs for last-fetched timestamp for that metadata URL and force-refresh if needed.
- Security: expedite CKU-900 given matching fingerprint and customer confirmation.

elaine.support: Sent steps and options to the customer. Will update thread once CKU approved or host-preserve confirms.
